An easy and unconventional way to cook eggs without boiling, keeping them soft and full of natural flavor. Perfect for breakfast or as an addition to salads and dishes.
Ingredients:
2 eggs
1 liter water
Preparation:
Pour water into a wide pot and heat until very hot but not fully boiling (around 80°–85°C).
Carefully add the eggs to the hot water.
Let the eggs cook for 7–10 minutes, depending on desired texture.
Remove carefully and serve immediately or use in other recipes.
